{{small|(25 July 2026)}} | average attendance = 12,124 | prevseason = [[2025–26 Swiss Super League|2025–26]] | nextseason = ''[[2027–28 Swiss Super League|2027–28]]'' | updated = 24 May 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Swiss Super League''' (referred to as the '''Brack Super League''' for sponsoring reasons) will be the 130th season of [[Swiss Super League|top-tier]] competitive [[Association football|football]] in [[Switzerland]], and the 24th under its current name. It will be the third season featuring a new format and increased number of participants, since the beginning of the Super League era in 2003. The defending champions are [[FC Thun|Thun]].{{cite web|url=https://sfl.ch/de/articles/fc-thun-ist-erstmals-schweizer-meister|title=FC Thun ist erstmals Schweizer Meister|language=german|website=Brack Super League |access-date=24 May 2026}} ==Overview== ===Format and schedule=== The Swiss Football League (SFL) released a detailed schedule on 28 November 2025:{{Cite web |date=2025-11-28 |title=Brack Super League 2026/27: First Official Dates |url=https://fclugano.com/en/news/brack-super-league-2026-27-le-prime-date-ufficiali |access-date=2026-05-24 |website=FC Lugano |language=en-US}} * The season will begin on 24 July 2026 and conclude on 30 May 2027. * The league will go on winter break after matchday 19 on 20 December 2026 and resume on 16 January 2027. The final matchday of the relegation group will take place on 27 May, while the championship group will hold its last matches 30 May 2026. * The two legs of the relegation play-offs are scheduled for 1 and 4 June 2027, respectively. The season is divided into two phases: * In a first phase all twelve teams play each other three times each, for a total of 33 matchdays and concludes on 12 April 2026. * Following that, the league is split into two groups of six each, one championship group and one relegation group. The second phase begins on 25 April 2026. ** Each team will play every other team in their group one time (five matches each), for a total of 38 matchdays. ** The championship group will play for the title of Swiss Football Champion and qualification for European championships. Final matchday is on 17 May 2026. ** The relegation group will play against relegation (last place) and the relegation play-off (second-to-last place). Final matchday will be on 4 June 2027. * Points won in the first phase are carried over to the second phase. ===Team changes=== [[FC Vaduz]] return to the top tier after a five-year absence.{{cite web|url=https://sfl.ch/de/articles/der-fc-vaduz-ist-meister-und-steigt-auf|title=Der FC Vaduz ist Meister und steigt auf|language=german|date=15 May 2026|access-date=24 May 2026}} [[FC Winterthur]]
